name: Living Competitive Intel
tagline: An always-current brief per competitor — refreshed weekly, shown as a diff, weighted so their marketing is never treated as truth.
who: Founders and sales teams who need to know what actually changed at each competitor — pricing, positioning, product — without re-reading everything weekly.
how: Name a competitor and the agent researches them in its browser — site, pricing, changelog, careers, reviews, community — and writes a living brief on its computer. On a weekly schedule it re-crawls and leads with the diff: what moved, dated, with the so-what. Every finding is weighted by claim type (deal evidence beats primary sources beats reviews beats their marketing), the load-bearing claims land as a short verify-before-acting list, and segment lenses cut the read by industry, geography, or company size, each leading with what to do.
